The founding town's map (Phase 016a). Moved from worlds/bigville_town100_world.py.

FOUNDING_MAP: width and height in cells. road_rows and road_cols give each winding road's line and the phase of its meander pattern. bend_offsets_* are the meander offsets and bend_run is the number of cells per pattern step (authored). square is the market square rectangle (x, y, w, h), its centre, and the label of the landmark. resource_bodies are the solid rectangles, given as inclusive corners [x0, y0, x1, y1], with the tile each one is. scattered_trees are single tree cells. farm_plots gives the origin, count, columns, and steps of the field grid. The layout is authored; there is no real-world source.

FOUNDING_DEPOSITS: the resource kinds the founding map places. Each sits on a walkable cell beside the body whose tile RESOURCE_DEPOSITS names for it (world/resource_deposits.json).
